ModInfo.description: Adds Tiny (44x44) and Teeny (34x34) map sizes and also Very Wide (40% of height) and Ultrawide (20% of height) aspect ratios (MP only). Intended for MP duels. I recommend combining Very Wide and Tiny on a mapscript that supports Mirror Maps. Works with most map scripts - Multiple Continents and Hardwood Forest can fail to generate correctly.
ModInfo.author: fluffybunnyOldWorld
